name: ai-bridge
description: Lets a local app on this machine send prompts to your GitHub Copilot model through a token-protected loopback endpoint.

aiBridge.port.description: Loopback port the bridge listens on (127.0.0.1 only). Must match the port in the app.

aiBridge.logConversations.description: Write each prompt received from the app and the model's reply to the AI Bridge output channel.

aiBridge.modelFamily.description: Preferred Copilot model family (for example gpt-4o). Leave empty to use any available model.
